scripts.dev: bun run content:build && bun run --cwd apps/app dev
scripts.web:build: bun run content:build && bun run --cwd apps/app export:web && bun scripts/sitemap.ts
scripts.web:build:release: bun scripts/build-content.ts --remote-audio && EXPO_PUBLIC_AUDIO_URL=https://audio.shawared.com bun run --cwd apps/app export:web:clean && bun scripts/sitemap.ts && bun scripts/web-release.ts --remote-audio
scripts.web:build:test: bun scripts/build-content.ts --remote-audio && bun scripts/test-audio.ts && EXPO_PUBLIC_AUDIO_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8788 bun run --cwd apps/app export:web:clean && bun scripts/sitemap.ts && bun scripts/web-release.ts
scripts.deploy:check: bun run web:build:release && bun run --cwd apps/app deploy:check
scripts.check: bun run content:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
